decision.summary: A single confirmed temporary offset in U (and coupled E) from index 608 to 612: sharp multi-sample drop in U (~3 MAD), smaller opposing dip in E, neutral N; U recovers fully by index 612, with E rebounding synchronously. The post-recovery 'platform' noted in screening (613–615) is not a sustained offset but part of the recovery tail—no additional offset interval is justified beyond 612. No other temporary offsets observed within allowed context [570,650].

intervals.observation: U-component shows abrupt drop (~3 MAD) starting at index 608, sustained through 610–611, with clear recovery beginning at 612; E-component exhibits smaller opposing dip (negative) during same span; N remains neutral. Return to pre-event trend is evident by index 612 on U, and E recovers concurrently. Interior is coherent and multi-sample; onset and return are distinct on U and E.
